## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: narrow Technology leadership (Top 5 are all Tech) and major divergence among megacaps (multiple large-cap names showing 1W vs 1M disagreement) justify a neutral stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology lead: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +17.22% | 1M: +21.06%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: LLY (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +8.55%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +12.71%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials solid: CAT (1W: +8.20% | 1M: +21.58%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication lagging: TMUS (1W: -9.12% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -9.25% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND, VZ (1W: -9.39% | 1M: -11.44%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate weak: AMT (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -10.20% | 1M: -16.27%) BELOW TREND. Technology pockets of weakness also present (QCOM, ORCL BELOW TREND).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +17.22% | 1M: +21.06%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +11.86% | 1M: +23.36%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +12.56%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CEG (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -13.69%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -18.85%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -9.12% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -9.25% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication and select REITs/Utilities.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +17.22% | 1M: +21.06%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged: several large caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META) show 1W vs 1M conflicts — this is a MAJOR Divergence, so treat momentum as tactical not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but active: Semiconductor-related names leading while large-cap software/hardware show 1M weakness; AAPL (1W: -1.68% | 1M: -7.27%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -9.47% | 1M: -26.11%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND. Sector 1W: +3.43% (24 stocks) — leadership concentrated in chip-equipment and semis.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed/rotational: V (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +3.97%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -2.04% | 1M: +9.36%) showing TREND EXHAUSTION. Sector 1W: -1.30% (20 stocks) — internal rotation, not broad strength.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Constructive: LLY (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +8.55%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +12.71%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND. Sector 1W: +3.14% (17 stocks) — confirmed accumulation in large-cap pharma/managed care names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Technology semicap and Healthcare exposure while reducing exposure to stretched communication and certain real estate names; Leadership is narrow so be selective. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat recent semicap strength as tactical rather than market-confirming due to major megacap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +17.22% | 1M: +21.06%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -11.27% | 1M: -35.09%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -9.47% | 1M: -26.11%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -9.12% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (semicap/ODM names driving gains; sector 1W: +3.43%). BEARISH: Communication & Real Estate (sector 1W: Communication -1.74%, Real Estate -2.79%) — watch for continued outflows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
AMAT: watch for continuation above this week’s breakout high for follow-through; LRCX: monitor for follow-through above recent 1W peak to confirm semicap leadership; ORCL: watch for failure to recover last month’s lows (continued 1M deterioration would signal deeper downside); V / MA: sustained ABOVE TREND momentum needs confirmation via next week’s relative-strength retention.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
MA (+60): MA (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +3.97%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment aligns with price (confirmed). V (+60): V (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strength. ABT (+80) is bullish in headlines but ABT timeframe not in the provided detail set for cross-check; monitor for confirmation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
GOOGL (-75): GOOGL (1W: +3.25% | 1M: -5.98%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — news is bearish and 1W/1M split is divergence (distribution risk). META (-70): META (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -10.86%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — negative headlines align with longer-term weakness. CVX (-50): CVX (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -9.15%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirm downside pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMAT, PANW, LRCX ABOVE TREND showing narrow Tech leadership while JNJ and LLY show Healthcare strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among large caps (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/GOOGL/META) and concentrated top-5 Tech leadership — monitor news-confirmation before expanding positions.
